articles.title: No GPS, no permits: Tamil Nadu bars mineral transport vehicles without tracking devices from Nov 1
articles.description: No vehicles will be allowed to transport minerals without GPS devices installed by November 1. The devices must be integrated with the state's MiMAS portal for real-time location tracking. Currently, around 1.10 lakh vehicles are registered, but only 50,000 actively transport minerals. Lorry owners must purchase devices from approved vendors, with costs now around ₹4000. Failure to comply will result in legal action against lorry owners.

articles.title: 80 feet above ground, 3 railway lines below: Nagpur Metro's 257-metre bridge uses construction technique that eliminates the need for scaffolding
articles.description: Nagpur Metro is constructing a 257-metre-long elevated bridge nearly 80 feet above railway tracks at Uppalwadi as part of its Phase-II expansion. The structure will cross three railway lines and is being built using the balanced cantilever technique, eliminating the need for scaffolding beneath it. The project is part of the 6.92-km Reach-2A corridor towards Kamptee.
